description: Written narrative analysis with source links, for when counts are not enough. 5 credits per call, so prefer trending or mentions when metrics will do. scope=market extracts the narratives moving the market. scope=keywords summarises events for keywords you supply, and can take over a minute to return.

from.description: Start of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with to.

keywords.description: Up to 5 comma separated keywords for scope=keywords.

maxNarratives.description: Cap the narratives returned for scope=market.

maxTweetsPerNarrative.description: Cap the sources per narrative for scope=market.

scope.description: market is a broad sweep. keywords needs the keywords argument.

searchType.description: How multiple keywords combine for scope=keywords.

to.description: End of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with from.

name: narratives
title: Narratives
